lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters (~10-25 pixels in diameter) arranged in approximately five semi-parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. These clusters exhibit a grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating high-contrast nodes at the points of intersection, most visible in the mid-body region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and a narrow band of shadowing immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs. These are non-uniformly distributed, with higher density in the anterior and basal regions of the fin mask.
